shape: 3-portal arena (S + E + W gates) with north + south clusters joined at the center
description: Three-portal arena with a clean split: the NORTH cluster (pmxf5r west entry + cadct1 + axutip) is a small triangle near the west gate. The SOUTH cluster (rw3753 south entry + bvkyv8 + xoetx6) is a triangle near the south gate. They're joined by ONE cross-bridge cadct1 ↔ bvkyv8 (center). The east gate connects via an SE chain (8e63dl east entry + q1y4dx + letji9, plus 8e63dl east entry hub). q1y4dx ↔ xoetx6 bridges south cluster to east cluster.

portals.south: spawn_south at (18.94, 23.42) — gate on the south (high-Z) side, east column
portals.east: spawn_east at (23.20, -16.95) — gate on the east (high-X) side, south of midline
portals.west: spawn_west at (-23.58, 5.86) — gate on the west (low-X) side

anchors.description: west entry hub - N cluster (matches pmxf5r)
south cluster east - bridge to east cluster (matches xoetx6)

traversalNotes: Direct W→S: spawn_west → west_inner → n_clique_c → s_clique_w → south_inner → spawn_south. 5 hops.
Direct S→E: spawn_south → south_inner → s_clique_e → se_step → east_inner → spawn_east. 5 hops via SE chain.
Direct W→E: spawn_west → west_inner → n_clique_c → s_clique_w → s_clique_e → se_step → east_inner → spawn_east. 7 hops.
STRICT BRIDGE: n_clique_c ↔ s_clique_w is the only N↔S link.
south_corner (letji9) has TWO connections (se_step + east_inner) — small east-side triangle.
DISPATCH RULE: cluster centers (n_clique_c, s_clique_w, se_step) are the routing anchors.
